title: openai-auth config
description: Configuration of the openai-auth command, which signs in to a ChatGPT account, refreshes its tokens and reports the state of the credential file the Go backend reads (model.json auth_mode openai_oauth). Every key is optional; the defaults are shown. The sign-in endpoints and the client id are not documented by OpenAI: the defaults are the ones the Codex CLI uses, found in the source of the openai-oauth library, so each is a key.

auth_file.description: Credential file. Absolute or starting with ~/, the rule model.json applies to oauth_auth_file. Use the same path there.

client_id.description: OAuth client id. The default is the Codex CLI's public client.

scope.description: Space separated scopes requested at sign-in.

authorize_params.description: Extra query parameters on the authorize URL. A value given here replaces the default set, it is not merged into it. The standard OAuth parameters are set by the tool and cannot be listed.

redirect_host.description: Host name in the redirect URI. The callback server listens on 127.0.0.1 and ::1.

login_port.description: Port of the sign-in callback. 0 picks a free port; the issuer may only accept the registered one.

login_timeout_ms.description: How long login waits for the browser redirect.

open_browser.description: Open the authorization URL in a browser. The --no-browser flag turns it off for one run. The URL is always printed.

expiry_margin_ms.description: How long before its expiry claim the access token counts as expired in status. Keep it equal to setting.json openai_oauth.expiry_margin_ms.

keep_backup.description: Keep the previous credential file as <auth_file>.bak (mode 0600) before each rewrite. One generation.
